errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies one of the x-axis categories as "事件处所" (Event Location), but the label in the figure is "部件处所" (Part Location).
The description claims all three bars for "空间实体" are 31.6%, but the figure shows the middle bar (validation set) is 31.3%.
The values for "事件" (Event) are reported as approximately 22.6%, 21.8%, and 21.5%. The correct values from the figure are 22.1%, 21.8%, and 21.7%.
The value for the validation set for "处所" (Location) is reported as 19.5%, but the figure shows it is 19.1%.
The value for the validation set for "方向" (Direction) is reported as 8.7%, but the figure shows it is 8.8%.

This part of the description contains multiple numerical errors. For example, for '原文时间', the test set is 4.2% not 4.7%. For '终点', the validation set is 4.4% not 4.6%. For '起点', the training and validation sets are 2.6% and 1.8%, not 2.7% and 2.6%. For '路径', the values are 1.0%, 1.5%, 1.1%, not 1.1%, 0.9%, 1.1%. For '部位', the validation set is 1.4%, not 1.0%.
